angles: Treat the 20% weekly turnover cap as a scarce budget to be spent, not a limit to be clipped against: each day, allocate a fixed slice of the budget to the single trade with the highest marginal benefit per unit turnover (expected log-growth gain plus risk-contribution reduction), so the constraints shape the signal into a priority queue instead of fighting it.

Make the correlation structure itself the signal: use only the rolling average pairwise correlation and the effective number of independent bets (eigenvalue concentration of the 10-asset covariance from daily closes) to scale total risk down when diversification is collapsing, on the reasoning that the 20% drawdown bound is broken by correlated sell-offs (2008, 2020, 2022) and not by any single asset's trend.

domains.text: Network congestion control (TCP AIMD and rate-limited senders): additive increase and multiplicative decrease of a sending window under a shared-capacity constraint, with backoff triggered by loss signals; analogous to slowly adding risk per asset, cutting it sharply on stress, and never exceeding a per-day transfer rate.

Ecological early-warning signals of tipping points (critical slowing down): rising variance and lag-1 autocorrelation in a system's state variable precede regime collapse; analogous to detecting fragility in cross-asset return series from daily closes before a correlated crash, then shifting weights toward the assets that recover fastest.
